posts.title: Sh2-188: The Shrimp Nebula
posts.lead: What causes the swirl in the Shrimp Nebula? Its high speed is likely. What is sure is that Sh2-188 is one of the larger planetary nebulas on the night sky, by angular size, spanning about half the diameter of the Moon.

posts.title: NASA, Boeing Share Update on Commercial Starliner Development Plans
posts.lead: On Monday, NASA and Boeing provided an update on the company’s Starliner spacecraft, including adding additional crew missions and certifying a new rocket for crew transportation to low Earth orbit.

posts.title: NASA Armstrong Celebrates 80 Years of Flight Innovation
posts.lead: On Sept. 30, 1946, five National Advisory Committee of Aeronautics (NACA) engineers arrived at Muroc Army Airfield in California’s high desert to achieve supersonic flight for the first time.

posts.title: Advanced Health Research Begins Week as Station Awaits Crew-13 Mission
posts.lead: Expedition 75 began the week scanning veins, checking out space workout gear, and testing specialized suits to ease the adjustment to Earth’s gravity. Back on Earth, NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 members are counting down to a launch on Oct. 1.

posts.title: NASA Highlights Lessons Learned From Swift Boost Mission
posts.lead: A commercial mission to boost NASA’s Swift observatory concluded without raising the spacecraft’s orbit, but the agency and industry vendor gained valuable experience that will benefit future in-space servicing programs.

posts.title: Dziesięciokątna fala wokół południowego bieguna Saturna
posts.lead: Północny biegun Saturna posiada unikalną cechę atmosferyczną w Układzie Słonecznym: trwałą falę heksagonalną z potężnym wirem w centrum. Do tej pory nie zaobserwowano podobnej fali w innych rejonach planety.

posts.title: Pierwsza europejska prywatna rakieta na orbicie. Udany drugi lot Spectrum
posts.lead: Historia widziała wiele przypadków szybkich zwrotów losów o 180 stopni. Natomiast dopracowanie rakiety orbitalnej w taki sposób, że w w ramach drugiego lotu dociera na orbitę, kiedy pierwszy zakończył się po 40 sekundach - to nowość.
